repos.name: pramana
repos.description: Deterministic verification gate for agent-initiated payments. No model on the money path.

manifests.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pramana"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Deterministic verification and policy gate for agent-initiated payments"
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }
requires-python = ">=3.11"
keywords = ["ap2", "agentic-payments", "mandate", "upi", "rbi", "verification"]

# Runtime dependencies.
#
# NOTE ON `ap2`: Google has NOT published AP2 to PyPI. The PyPI name `ap2`
# belongs to an unrelated publisher and `ap2-sdk` is an empty placeholder.
# Installing either would be a supply-chain incident. We install from the
# upstream git repository at a PINNED COMMIT SHA -- never a tag, never HEAD.
# See docs/adr/0002-pin-ap2-by-commit-sha.md
dependencies = [
    "ap2 @ git+https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2@e1ea56db72a6385bce3e5c1112b3a56ce60acb43",
    "fastapi>=0.115",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.32",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "rfc8785>=0.1",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.3",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24",
    "httpx>=0.27",
    "ruff>=0.7",
    "mypy>=1.13",
    "types-PyYAML",
    "httpx>=0.27",
]

[project.scripts]
pramana = "pramana.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["pramana*", "bench*"]

# The default policy ships inside the package. Resolving it by a path relative
# to the working directory meant `pytest` from tests/ produced 34 failures and
# `pramana bench` from any other directory could not find it at all.
[tool.setuptools.package-data]
pramana = ["policies/*.yaml"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ruff
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88
target-version = "py311"
extend-exclude = [".venv", ".claude", "build", "dist"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E", "W",    # pycodestyle
    "F",         # pyflakes
    "I",         # isort
    "N",         # pep8-naming
    "UP",        # pyupgrade
    "B",         # flake8-bugbear
    "A",         # flake8-builtins
    "C4",        # flake8-comprehensions
    "DTZ",       # flake8-datetimez -- timezone-aware datetimes only
    "T20",       # flake8-print -- no stray print() on the money path
    "SIM",       # flake8-simplify
    "PTH",       # flake8-use-pathlib
    "RUF",       # ruff-specific
    "S",         # flake8-bandit -- security
    "ANN",       # flake8-annotations -- everything typed
    "TRY",       # tryceratops
    "PL",        # pylint
]
ignore = [
    "ANN401",    # Any is occasionally required at protocol boundaries
    "TRY003",    # long messages outside exception class are fine here
    "PLR0913",   # predicate constructors legitimately take several args
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**" = ["S101", "ANN", "PLR2004"]   # asserts and magic numbers are the point
"bench/**" = ["S101", "ANN"]
# CLI tools; stdout is their entire purpose.
"scripts/**" = ["T201", "ANN", "BLE001", "PLR0915"]
"pramana/cli.py" = ["T201"]
# safe_print is a print wrapper; printing is its purpose.
"pramana/console.py" = ["T201"]
# RUF001/RUF002 flag ambiguous Unicode. In this file the ambiguous characters
# ARE the subject under test -- U+202F is the exact character that crashed a
# live demo. Suppressing the rule here is the point, not an oversight.
"tests/unit/test_console.py" = ["RUF001", "RUF002", "RUF003"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
ban-relative-imports = "all"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# mypy -- strict. The money path is not a place for implicit Any.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
strict = true
warn_unreachable = true
warn_return_any = true
disallow_any_generics = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
no_implicit_optional = true
show_error_codes = true
pretty = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
# The upstream AP2 SDK ships no py.typed marker. `jwcrypto` is AP2's own key
# type, reached only where we hand a JWK straight back to AP2 -- see
# pramana/adapters/ap2_chain.py. Neither is on the decision path.
module = ["ap2.*", "jwcrypto.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# pytest
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
addopts = [
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
    "-ra",
]
markers = [
    "unit: fast, no I/O",
    "integration: crosses a real boundary",
    "bench: frozen attack-benchmark case",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["pramana"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = ["pragma: no cover", "if TYPE_CHECKING:", "raise NotImplementedError"]

{
  "name": "globetrotter",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.15.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.12.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm -r build",
    "typecheck": "pnpm -r typecheck",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "test": "pnpm -r build && pnpm -r test",
    "db:up": "docker compose up -d",
    "db:down": "docker compose down",
    "db:migrate": "docker compose run --rm migrate",
    "db:status": "docker compose exec -T postgres /db/scripts/migrate.sh status",
    "dev": "pnpm --filter @globetrotter/api dev"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.10.2",
    "eslint": "^9.17.0",
    "eslint-plugin-boundaries": "^5.0.1",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.18.1",
    "@eslint/js": "^9.17.0",
    "eslint-import-resolver-typescript": "^3.7.0"
  }
}
